name: Price Guardrails
description: Per-SKU limits an agent-proposed price must stay inside: floor, ceiling, maximum change per step, and whether all agent channels must show the same price.

label.en: Set a price guardrail for a SKU
label.zh-CN: 给某个 SKU 设价格护栏

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-agent-orders` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then add or update the guardrail for the SKU I name: floor, ceiling, maximum change per step, and whether every channel must show the same price.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先读这个文件夹里的 `busa-agent-orders` 技能并按它的流程做，然后为我指定的 SKU 新增或更新护栏：最低价、最高价、单次最大改价幅度、是否要求所有渠道同价。

label.en: Which SKUs sold through agents have no guardrail?
label.zh-CN: 哪些通过智能体卖出的 SKU 还没有护栏？

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-agent-orders` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then list SKUs that appear in agent orders but have no guardrail row.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先读这个文件夹里的 `busa-agent-orders` 技能并按它的流程做，然后列出出现在智能体订单里、但还没有护栏的 SKU。
